text: Rather than summon the village guards to search the huts, Grandmother Awa held up her hand.
She placed a large earthenware water pot in the center of the dark storeroom, covered it with a white sheet, and called all the daughters and cousins into the room.
'The spirits of our ancestors do not tolerate deceit,' the grandmother said quietly.
'Let each daughter enter this room alone in the dark, place her right hand into the covered jar, and leave.
If her heart is clean, the water will smell of sweet mint.
If the jewelry is returned into the pot before the candle burns down, no name will ever be spoken in shame.'
